# Hejmdal Privathospital Aalborg

Hejmdal Privathospital Aalborg is a private hospital department (afdeling) named in the Danish ADHD-databasen's 2024 quality report, a national dataset tracking ADHD assessment and treatment across Danish regions and psychiatric departments [^src1][^src2][^src3]. The department appears in tables reporting performance on quality indicator 2b, which measures the frequency of manualized diagnostic interviews or environmental observation during ADHD workups for children and young people [^src1][^src2]. Its listed result is "0 (0-84)" with "Nej" (No) marked against it, indicating that Hejmdal Privathospital Aalborg achieved 0 % fulfilment of indicator 2b [^src1][^src2] — well below the national development target of 90 % fulfilment that the report applies across all departments.

This result sits within a broader national picture described in the source document: across Denmark, indicator 2b reached only 51 % fulfilment on average for the period 01.04.2024–31.03.2025, alongside indicator 3 (diagnostic conferences with specialist physicians) at 27 %, with significant regional variation — some departments, such as those in Vejle and Aabenraa, achieved 100 % on related indicator 2a, while others, including departments in Region Sjælland and Region Nordjylland, fell well short of the target. The report attributes such shortfalls to barriers including geographic challenges, registration problems, and variable waiting times [^src1][^src2]. Hejmdal Privathospital Aalborg is also listed, without additional detail, in the report's later appendix material covering the steering group and database population statistics [^src3].

Beyond its appearance in these indicator tables, no further detail, relationships, or claims about Hejmdal Privathospital Aalborg are present in the corpus. This is an honest reflection of a thin evidence set: the entity is documented solely through its inclusion in national ADHD quality-indicator reporting.
